instruction: Use the already opened Bonsai/Blender IFC authoring environment and its CLI/API tools to update /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and save the finished model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. Do not create, rewrite, copy, patch, or post-process the IFC outside that software environment. The model is a minimal steel frame study with four columns, four beams, and a deck slab. The structural engineer wants a coordination-ready analysis package without changing the physical frame. Preserve the storey, column, beam, and slab geometry, then organise the frame members and deck into one primary structural analysis model that can be recognised by downstream tools. Record the frame coordination with revision code BONSAI-CLI-08 on the analysis model and the assigned products.
